# scAnnoX: Single Cell Annotation eXplorer

A comprehensive R package for single-cell RNA-seq annotation using multiple annotation tools and methods.

## Installation

```r
devtools::install_github("alyssafubuki-collab/scAnnoX")
```

## Features

- Multiple annotation methods integration
- Automated cell type annotation
- Marker gene detection
- Cell clustering tools

## Usage

See vignettes and man pages for detailed usage examples.
